## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Operational impact

Explain effects on existing installations, state, container reconstruction, updates, and rollback.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Docker integration tests pass or the reason they were not run is documented
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] No credentials, internal addresses, private image names, or production screenshots are included
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are explicit

## Security considerations

Describe changes involving authentication, Docker socket access, registries, secrets, or external requests.
